subject: Coordinating ClearEdge console + API onboarding (APAC night windows)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Li <sophia@clearedge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed console + API onboarding slots (ClearEdge APAC pilot)

Hi Sophia —

Thanks again for picking Redwood for the APAC pilot. To get the console walkthrough and API enablement scheduled, here are two options that keep latency-sensitive work in an APAC-friendly window while allowing our US-based SMEs to join:

- Option A: Wed, 16 Sep — 22:00 SGT (09:00 PDT) — full-day combined session (3.5h with break)
- Option B: Thu, 17 Sep — split sessions: console (09:00 SGT / 00:00 PDT) + API deep-dive (15:00 SGT / 06:00 PDT)

Please ping which of the two you prefer and who from your side will own access provisioning (service accounts + test data). If neither works, send 2-3 windows that do and we’ll re-propose.

Attached: ClearEdge_Onboarding_SOW.pdf (high-level SOW) and session_agenda_v1.md (draft).

Goals for the sessions: fast console onboarding, API key issuance, sample request/response walkthrough, and a short run-through of our SDK integration tips so your eng team can hit first calls within 48 hours post-session.

Next steps I propose after we lock a date: send calendar invites (we’ll include two instructors), pre-flight credentials request list, and a short checklist for networking/allowlisting.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Partnerships (EMEA/APAC) | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0191

Attachments: ClearEdge_Onboarding_SOW.pdf (pdf), session_agenda_v1.md (markdown)

Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom@clearedge.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:45:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Proposed console + API onboarding slots (ClearEdge APAC pilot)

Hi Aditya —

Appreciate the options. Quick update from our side: leadership has an all-hands on 16 Sep evening local time, so Option A won’t work for the core team. Option B might be feasible but splitting sessions across days adds logistics complexity for our infra folks.

Can you do Wed, 15 Sep (evening SGT) or Thu, 23 Sep (late-morning SGT)? Those give us better internal coverage. Also: procurement is asking for the final SOW and a DocuSign before we can share a sandbox dataset — do you have an updated SOW we can sign this week?

Thanks —

Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed console + API onboarding slots (ClearEdge APAC pilot)

Thanks Sophia — small note from ops: splitting the sessions is fine if ClearEdge prefers fewer concurrent stakeholders. We usually run a compact console onboarding (75–90 minutes) that covers the console flows and then a separate 90–120 minute API deep-dive with hands-on requests.

If you want to avoid two separate days, we can also do a single evening session that compresses both topics into a 3.5-hour block with a 20-minute break in the middle. We’ll staff it with two instructors (one console lead, one API lead).

We can get the final SOW to you today and send a DocuSign link. For the sandbox dataset, we need a PO or signed SOW to provide the preprovisioned workspace.

Availability (Redwood instructors):
- Wed 15 Sep: available 21:00–00:00 SGT
- Thu 23 Sep: available 09:00–13:00 SGT or 20:00–23:30 SGT

If any of those align with ClearEdge stakeholder windows, we’ll lock it and circulate invites.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
